# MPSStateEncoding

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Encoding the temporal state of a chaotic system as a matrix product state (MPS), a tensor network with a linear topology, to capture correlations across time steps. Provides a topology-centric representation that maps naturally to distributed or in-network processing, reducing memory and communication overhead for real-time prediction.
